name: helturkey/arabic-prosody
description: Dependency-free Arabic prosody (ʿarūḍ): vocalized text to binary scansion, rule-based meter detection for hemistichs, verses, whole poems and free verse, with foot-by-foot explanations.

scripts.lint: find src bin tools tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.ci: Lint, run the test suite and the corpus regression gate.

suggest.helturkey/php-arabic-support: Optional Arabic text-cleaning helpers; PHP Arud itself has no runtime dependencies and preserves diacritics for scansion.
